papers.title: Kinematic Hypothesis Context: Embodiment-Conditioned Learned Video Coding for Bandwidth-Limited Robot Policy Uplinks
papers.abstract_snippet: Robots increasingly run large vision-language-action policies on remote servers, making the camera uplink the bottleneck. Existing video codecs spend bits on content the receiver could predict: the robot's own motion. We introduce the kinematic hypothesis context, a zero-rate conditioning signal that both ends build from joint states, the robot model and the camera calibration. papers.reason: 把机器人自身运动学作为零比特的条件信号注入学习型视频编码，让远端 VLA 推理的相机上行只传「无法预测」的残差，压缩云端部署带宽。属部署层工程优化，无机器人操作实验证据，暂不列入可复用清单。

papers.title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
papers.abstract_snippet: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation targe
papers.reason: 把预训练视频生成器改造成统一的第一人称动作-视频模型，同时做动作条件视频生成、位姿估计与联合动作-视频生成，为利用大规模人类自我中心视频提供了一条路线。但摘要仅给出目标与角色分工，缺机器人操作实验与量化对比。

papers.title: A high-dimensional population code in the bat motor cortex during natural dexterous flight
papers.abstract_snippet: Bats use their hand-like wings to reproduce natural flights with wingbeat-level precision. Rather than mainly tracking the wingbeat cycle, the wing motor cortex generates sparse, distinct population states with little shared variance across wingbeats, resulting in a high-dimensional code distinct from that typically observed in constrained tasks.
papers.reason: 蝙蝠飞行运动皮层的神经群体编码研究，属神经科学，与机器人 VLA 架构、训练、数据、部署均无实质关联。
